articles.text: SECRETARY: Hello. Department of American and Oceanic Affairs.
DÁFĒI XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ shi Dàshǐguǎnde Dáfēi. Wǒ yǒu yíjiàn shì xiǎng gēn Wáng Kēzhǎng jiǎngyijiǎng.
MR. DUFFY: I'm Duffy of the Embassy. I have something I'd like to discuss with Section Chief Wáng.
MÌSHŪ: Ou, tā xiànzài zài kāi huì.
SECRETARY: Oh, she is at a meeting now.
DÁFĒI XIĀNSHENG: Yìhuǐr qǐng ta gěi wo huí ge diànhuà, hǎo bu hǎo?
MR. DUFFY: In a little while, please ask her to call me back. All right?
MÌSHŪ: Hǎo. Děng tā kāiwán huì wǒ gàosong ta.
SECRETARY: Fine. When she finishes the meeting, I'll tell her.
MÌSHŪ: Bú xiè. Shénme shíhou duì nín héshì?
SECRETARY: Don't mention it. What time would suit you?
DÁFĒI XIĀNSHENG: Míngtian xiàwǔ shénme shíhou dōu kěyi.
MR. DUFFY: Any time tomorrow afternoon would be fine.
